info.title: Timely Universal API
info.description: The Timely API allows you to integrate time tracking into your applications and workflows. Use it to sync projects, log time entries, export reports, and automate time management.

post.description: Creates a bulk import job for time entries in Timely.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

create[].description: Array of time entries to create. Each item accepts all standard event/time entry fields from PayloadSchema.

update[].description: Array of time entries to update. Must include id field. All other fields from UpdatePayloadSchema are optional.

delete[].description: Array of time entry IDs to delete
